intro: Convert ounces (oz) to grams (g) accurately for baking recipes, nutrition labels, postal scales, and dry ingredient portions. Under the International Yard and Pound Agreement, 1 avoirdupois ounce equals exactly 28.349523125 grams—multiply your ounce value by 28.349523125 for full precision. Use the calculator above or scan the oz scale chart below for exact weights from 1/8 oz to 300 oz.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Avoirdupois Ounces (oz) vs. Silver/Gold Troy Ounces (oz t) vs. Liquid Fluid Ounces (fl oz)
items: Grocery, baking, and postal scales use the Avoirdupois ounce (1 oz = 28.349523125 g). Precious metals like silver, gold, and platinum use the Troy ounce (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), which is 9.7% heavier.

Liquid fluid ounces (fl oz) measure volume, not mass. Converting liquid ounces to grams requires the ingredient's density (1 US fl oz of water weighs ~29.57 g, whereas honey weighs ~42 g and cooking oil ~27 g).

faqs.question: Is an ounce bigger than a gram?
faqs.answer: Yes. One avoirdupois ounce is 28.34952 times heavier than a gram (1 oz = 28.349523125 g, whereas 1 g = 0.03527 oz).

faqs.question: How many grams are in a quarter ounce (1/4 oz) or one eighth of an ounce (1/8 oz)?
faqs.answer: A quarter ounce (0.25 oz) equals 7.08738 grams (commonly rounded to 7.09 g or 7.1 g), and one eighth of an ounce (0.125 oz) equals 3.54369 grams (roughly 3.54 g).

faqs.question: How many ounces are in a gram of silver?
faqs.answer: Silver and other precious metals are weighed in troy ounces (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g), so 1 gram of silver equals 0.03215 troy ounces (1 ÷ 31.1034768), compared with 0.03527 standard avoirdupois ounces.

faqs.question: How do I convert ounces to grams (oz to g)?
faqs.answer: Multiply avoirdupois ounces by 28.349523125 (or 28.3495 for everyday cooking). For example, 8 oz × 28.349523125 = 226.79619 g.
